definition: Natural log of one plus accepted records per window-second.
interpretationLimit: This is not a raw packets-per-second value; use a unit-labelled tool measurement.

definition: Distinct accepted address values divided by accepted record count.
interpretationLimit: A small positive fraction is not zero addresses or a verified count of physical devices.

definition: Shannon entropy of accepted address frequencies divided by log2 of record count, with a one-record fallback of zero.
interpretationLimit: Address concentration is not the random/public address-type flag or proof of address-generation behavior.

definition: Fraction of accepted records whose address is absent from the supplied previous-address set.
interpretationLimit: Zero newly observed addresses does not mean public addresses or absence of random-address flags.

definition: One minus distinct accepted advertising-data hashes divided by accepted record count.
interpretationLimit: Hash equality is exact data equality, not approximate similarity, intent, constant length, or identity.

definition: Fraction of accepted records carrying the decoded random-address-type flag.
interpretationLimit: This does not measure how often an address changes or verify how an address was generated.

definition: Fraction of accepted records with a parsed manufacturer-specific AD structure.
interpretationLimit: This does not authenticate a manufacturer, device, or sender.

definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 0 (ADV_IND).
interpretationLimit: The advertised capability is not proof that a connection was established.

definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 2 (ADV_NONCONN_IND).
interpretationLimit: Nonconnectable advertising is not a record of whether scanning occurred or a full connection history.

definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 4 (SCAN_RSP).
interpretationLimit: A record fraction is not a count of unique scanners or all devices present.

definition: Fraction of accepted records whose legacy advertising PDU kind is 6 (ADV_SCAN_IND).
interpretationLimit: Scannable advertising is not an observed scan request or proof that a scanner was present.

definition: Population standard deviation of adjacent accepted-record time gaps divided by their positive mean; otherwise zero.
interpretationLimit: Variability alone is not hostility; gaps depend on capture visibility and timestamp validity.

definition: Natural log of one plus mean adjacent accepted-record interval in seconds, with an insufficient-interval fallback of zero.
interpretationLimit: This is not raw milliseconds; zero may reflect insufficient intervals, not instantaneous activity.

definition: Natural log of one plus maximum adjacent accepted-record interval in seconds, with an insufficient-interval fallback of zero.
interpretationLimit: It is not a proof of environmental radio silence or a complete capture-duration measurement.

definition: Mean length in bytes of extracted accepted advertising data.
interpretationLimit: An average does not establish constant packet or payload size.

definition: Population standard deviation of extracted accepted advertising-data lengths in bytes.
interpretationLimit: A positive value means lengths vary; do not call them constant.

definition: This decoder admits legacy advertising PDU kinds 0, 1, 2, 4 and 6.
interpretationLimit: Scan-request and connection-request traffic is outside these accepted features; do not infer their absence from this vector.
